name: Anu LMS Demo content
description: Creates demo courses, categories and lessons for Anu LMS on install; removes them on uninstall.
project_description: Submodule of Anu LMS. On install (hook_modules_installed) it programmatically creates a demo catalogue: course categories and labels, a filtered courses landing page, a course exercising every lesson paragraph type (headings, text, lists, images, highlights, dividers, embedded video, checklists, tables) and a course demonstrating module/lesson/section navigation, plus a cover image. All created entity IDs are recorded in Drupal state and deleted on uninstall. Intended for evaluation and testing, not production.
